topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Hey, I just have to tell you, life has this funny way of surprising us, doesn’t it? I found out about the mix-up with your job, and you know what? I’m just glad you’re okay, genuinely. It’s a whirlwind out there, and I’m thinking, maybe this is the chance for you to find something that’s a perfect fit, where you get to light up the room just by being there. We all need that, a space where we can be our best selves, you know? So, while things might feel a bit mixed up right now, let’s turn this into an adventure. We’ll figure it out, every step of the way, and I’m all in, ready to cheer you on. Let’s make this a story to tell over coffee one day, with huge smiles. You’ve got this!
